title: GlossMark ledger entry
description: One line of .glossmark/ledger.jsonl: provenance and review state for one inline @gloss marker. Mirrors model.LedgerEntry in internal/model/files.go (JSON tags, snake_case). The first line is a header {type: ledger, format, generator}; every other line is an entry.

marker_id.description: Stable marker id: the id= key when given, else a content hash of the form m-<10 hex>.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the file holding the marker.

targets.description: Target texts as written in the marker (.Local, zoo:Foal, impl:NEW:Gelding, pa:*).

actor.description: Who placed the marker, as kind:name (human:alice, agent:claude).

model.description: Model identifier when an agent placed the marker.

conf.description: Confidence of a proposed link, in [0,1].

created.description: When the entry was first recorded (RFC 3339, UTC).

reviewed_by.description: Actor who accepted or rejected the marker.

anchor_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the anchored signature (or file) at review time; a mismatch marks the entry stale.

rationale.description: The marker's note= text or the sidecar key.

gate.description: Gate class recorded for the entry (reserved; not currently written by the tooling).

last_seen.description: When the marker was last found in the source (RFC 3339, UTC).
